name: Studio
avoid_for: Contexts that should feel quiet or institutional — the black-and-electric-yellow palette is the loudest in the library
weak_cases: Paragraph-heavy slides and many competing objects defeat the single massive headline.
visual_signature: Barlow graphic mass, acid-yellow/near-black inversion and flat hairlines.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Uppercase graphic mass does not transfer unchanged to caseless scripts; choose actual text and weight before fitting.

assets.images: Optional cover imagery supports one dominant headline; no decorative asset is required.
